rows.source_quote: The Riverside Military Academy Corps of Cadets earned its seventh consecutive President's Trophy for most outstanding entry in the 35th annual Atlanta Veterans' Day Parade held last month in downtown Atlanta.

rows.comments: The source explicitly states that Brian Wilkins cut the ribbon (official opening) and that he has been using the beach since 1938.
rows.source_quote: And cutting the ribbon will be Brian Wilkins, 82, who has been using the beach since 1938 and been an enthusiastic supporter of the campaign to get it back open.

rows.comments: The article, dated November 14, 2018, states the Arts Board criticized the original search for lack of inclusivity and noted the flag might return to the drawing board.
rows.source_quote: The City of Milwaukee's Arts Board said this week that the original search in recent years wasn't inclusive enough ... The search for the 'People's Flag' of Milwaukee could be heading back to the drawing board.

rows.comments: The source states that the team received keys to the city, but it does not say that each individual player received a key.
rows.source_quote: U.S. women's national soccer team and reigning 2015 World Cup champions are showered in confetti at the end of a ceremony at City Hall in New York City after receiving keys to the city, July 10, 2015.

rows.comments: The source explicitly states that the name change will be fully implemented during the 2018‑2019 academic year, directly supporting the claim.
rows.source_quote: Full implementation of the name change will take place over the coming 2018-2019 academic year.

rows.comments: The source explicitly states the ads were timed to air immediately after the songs and that Dan Lovinger said the ads were intended to enhance excitement for families.
rows.source_quote: Indeed, Walmart will air five thirty-second ads in all, each timed to run just after the song being featured in each spot has been sung in the show. NBC hopes the show will bring families together and 'kind of wanted this to enhance the excitement,' said Dan Lovinger, exec veep of entertainment ad sales at NBCU.

rows.comments: The source explicitly states the film was screened in the U.S. and Canada in May 2018 and later became available for streaming on November 1, 2018.
rows.source_quote: Crunchyroll already screened the film in the United States and Canada in May as part of its Anime Movie Night series ... Film to be available for free users on November 1.

rows.comments: The source lists the 32nd Training Squadron under the 1st Air Wing but does not state that it is based at Hamamatsu Air Base in Shizuoka Prefecture.

The source explicitly states that the coalition recruited AQAP fighters as "exceptional fighters" and that many of their gains were achieved through secret deals that paid AQAP members to leave key locations without firing a shot, directly supporting the claim.
rows.source_quote: Coalition-backed militias actively recruit al-Qaida militants, or those who were recently members, because they're considered exceptional fighters, the AP found ... many of their conquests came without firing a shot. That's because the coalition cut secret deals with al-Qaida fighters, paying some to leave key cities and towns and letting others retreat with weapons, equipment and wads of looted cash, an investigation by The Associated Press has found.

rows.source_quote: An 11-year NFL veteran, Roy Lee Hilton died Sunday at Gilchrist Center Towson. The Randallstown resident, who suffered from Alzheimer's disease and dementia, was 75.
